description: Bassins de rétention is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Localisation des bassins de rétention du réseau départemental d'assainissement. Ce jeu de données localise les bassins de rétention, à ciel ouvert ou enterrés, du réseau départemental d'assainissement dont le maître d'ouvrage est le Département. Lexique EP Réseau séparatif eaux pluviales UN Réseau unitaire. Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Equipement / Services. Its keywords are assainissement. The portal shows 11 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
